title: Five Little Ducks 🦆 Quack, Quack, Quack! | Tiny Tune Town Nursery Rhymes & Kids Songs
intro: Five little ducks swim in the sun, splash, splash, splash! One little duck hides, then another, and Ollie the octopus counts them down from five to one. At the end Mama Duck calls quack, quack, quack and all five ducklings hurry back. A gentle counting sing-along for toddlers and preschoolers, with a new tune and new words.
actions: Hold up five fingers and put one down each time a duck hides
Flap your arms like little wings and say quack, quack, quack
Cover your eyes for hide and seek
Open your arms wide when Mama calls the ducklings back
credit: Traditional idea of counting ducks down from five, with new words and music by Tiny Tune Town.
